messages:
nina: quick alert 1: SAST started failing after the RBAC rollout to keystore; scanners report KMS Decrypt 403s. Anyone oncall?
ben: seen in staging, reproduces locally for svc-scan-runner identity. PR that changed bindings is #4201.
secbot: [alert] CI job 11023 failed: sast-scan (https://ci.redwood.example/jobs/11023) :warning:
leo: short-term: apply ephemeral decrypt role to svc-scan-runner, record binding id, then rerun jobs. long-term: RBAC rollout must run a mock-decrypt smoke test for affected SAs.
nina: creating incident INC-2026-2001 for triage and postmortem. Please capture KMS audit logs for Decrypt calls between 3123456700-3123456900.
ben: applying ephemeral grant now, will post binding fingerprint and trigger rerun.
secbot: [automation] re-run requested for CI job 11023 by leo.
leo: rerun passed. revoking ephemeral grant and pausing the rollout. I9ll open a PR to add the mock-decrypt step to the RBAC deploy job (simple `gcloud kms decrypt` call as each SA).
nina: thanks 1 :thumbsup: assigning postmortem to me and runbook update to ben.
